notes.title: Girls in Glasses Cards are Dropping!
notes.content:
We have now added cards to Girls in Glasses on Steam! You can either make use of the points shop to buy backgrounds and emotes or wait for card drops in game and trade with other users. Happy collecting and enjoy the release. ːkana_mebusakiːːkotomi_gareiː
